I_ACCESS.description: Users report being unable to log in or access their accounts, sometimes after repeated attempts.

I_BILLING.description: Users describe premium prompts, difficulty signing up for Premium, and limited access to music without a subscription.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs or lyrics, repetitive playback choices, and recommendations that have worsened.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report trouble downloading music, listening offline, and keeping downloaded files available.

I_OTHER.description: Users express broad dissatisfaction with the app or say a recent update needs rework.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report playback that stops, fails to start, shows a blank screen, or plays unexpected content.

I_USABILITY.description: Users report changed or missing controls, difficulty navigating playlists or finding features, and frequent ads.
